title: Jose's GitHub account on the roster, so his agents' keys can be sealed to (L6)
detail: Jose asked (3 November, about 01:00 UTC) for riskmandate-jose to be added to data/team.json for jose. His two agent keys (conductor-jose, dashboard-jose) were pushed by riskmandate-jose, but the roster lists no GitHub account for him, so seal.mjs refuses them and he cannot reach L6. WS-106 leaves the roster change to conductor@web-summit.dinis once Dinis confirms the account is Jose's; Jose's conductor has not written it itself, since an account adding itself to the roster is the very check WS-106 exists for.
recommend: Dinis confirms riskmandate-jose before the stand-up and his conductor adds it; Vicky's account (riskmandate-vicky) is in the same position and could go in the same change
options: Dinis confirms, and conductor@web-summit.dinis adds riskmandate-jose to the roster
Jose reads his agents' fingerprints to the sealer out of band (--fingerprint) instead
